'''2009 US West Nationals Day 1 Matt Schuitt DS ISB Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Matt Schuitt]] at [[2009 US West Nationals]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Deck name:''' STOLEN
* '''Username:''' mls8306
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS17]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
